urban_hex_mesh_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Streetwear geometric hex mesh casing. Sliced in soft 85A TPU with a strict -0.30mm horizontal tolerance modifier to completely neutralize rubber material thermal expansion. This ensures the long T-shaped male splines slide smoothly into the un-jammable debris channels of the sole base without friction seizure.

tactical_boot_exoskeleton_tpu_90a.structural_purpose: High-top tactical outdoor boot chassis. Sliced in dense 90A TPU at 5 wall perimeters to resist tearing. Includes the expanded -0.30mm horizontal clearance modifier so that the thickened male rails slide effortlessly into place and drive cleanly beneath the overlocking front crocodile hood pocket.

runner_recovery_slide_tpu_80a.structural_purpose: Ultra-lightweight open toe-box recovery slide strap. Sliced at a fine 0.16mm track height in soft 80A TPU to maximize skin comfort, hardcoding the -0.30mm clearance index so that the slide strap can be snapped onto the shared sole by hand in under 5 seconds.
